title: Equipment Datasheet - SOLVENT HEATER (EA-5601)
content:
EQUIPMENT DATASHEET: EA-5601 (SOLVENT HEATER).
Document No: TJC-LLD-DS-EA-5601, Revision: Rev 3, Status: Issued for Operation.
Equipment Type: Shell & Tube Heat Exchanger (BEM).
Plant Unit: Linear Low Density Polyethylene (LLDPE) Unit, Area: 5600 – Solvent Recovery System.
Functional Location: TJC-LLD-5600-01, Criticality: Low Critical.
Service: Heat recovered hexane solvent using MP steam before recycle.
MECHANICAL SPECIFICATIONS:
TEMA Type: BEM, HORIZONTAL; Tube Length: 6000 mm; No. of Tubes: 246; Duty: 1.85 MW; Tube Passes: 2; Shell Side Fluid: MP STEAM 10 barg; Tube Material: SS304L; Tube Side Fluid: HEXANE SOLVENT; Shell Material: SA-516 Gr.70; Shell Design P/T: 13 barg / 200 °C; Tubesheet: SA-516-70 + SS304 overlay; Tube Design P/T: 16 barg / 200 °C; Baffle: SEGMENTAL 25% CUT; Tube OD x BWG: 19.05 mm x 14 BWG; Gasket: SPIRAL WOUND SS316/GRAPHITE
PERFORMANCE DATA:
Heat Transfer Area: 88 m2; Steam Consumption: 3100 kg/h; Clean U: 620 W/m2K; Solvent Inlet T: 45 °C; Service U: 480 W/m2K; Solvent Outlet T: 95 °C; Fouling (Tube): 0.00035 m2K/W; Pressure Drop (Tube): 0.35 bar; Driver Type: None (static)
CROSS REFERENCES: P&ID: TJC-LLD-PID-5601, Interlock: N/A (control loop only).
